recipes.title: Buttermilk Lemonade Fried Chicken (Chef Chris Scott)

items.i: chicken drumsticks (or a whole chicken cut into 8)
lemon zest and flaky sea salt, to finish

steps: Whisk the brine ingredients until dissolved. Put the chicken in bags, pour over the brine and seal (vacuum-sealing pushes the flavor in fast). Refrigerate 1–4 hours.
Move the chicken to a clean container, cover with buttermilk and rest 1 hour.
Heat oil to 325°F (165°C). Combine the flour, cornmeal, cornstarch and baking powder, and dredge the chicken straight from the buttermilk.
Fry in batches without crowding, about 12 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C) inside. If frying mixed pieces, start with the breasts, which take longest.
Drain, rest briefly and finish with lemon zest and sea salt.
recipes.notes: Recipe from the chef's published recipe (the 'level 3' version in the video); macros are estimated per 2 drumsticks, including absorbed oil.
